Ranking matches by substring, so the stored «Блокнот» is found inside «блокноты» but not inside «блокнотов», and no list of filler words addresses inflection. The rule is now inverted: a sentence is matched by stem against the storefront's real vocabulary (product names, seller search terms, category names) and the catalog's own form is what is searched; filler is dropped because no product contains it. Only when nothing grounds is a model asked to map the meaning onto that same closed vocabulary, and its answer is intersected with the live vocabulary and real category ids before any search, so it can choose among the store's products but never introduce one. searchPublishedProducts and rankCatalogProducts remain unchanged. The «Не нашли по условию» line is retired in favour of «Искали: …». Recorded as D-042, which supersedes the D-040 clause that the only model in the request path is speech-to-text. open_items.summary: The automation Worker has no LLM provider key, so a scheduled seo_draft_generation job fails closed with the non-retryable llm_provider_missing and writes no draft. Owner-triggered generation through Pages is unaffected, because Pages holds the provider secrets. Setting one of MISTRAL_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY, CEREBRAS_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY as a secret on the gptbot-automation Worker completes unattended scheduled generation. Cloudflare secrets cannot be read back, so the value has to come from the owner.

Cloudflare Pages production carries a secret_text variable literally named ___ , almost certainly a residue of the earlier empty-named KV binding incident. It is read by no code. Left in place because R0.4 authorised removing only the TEST_MERGE_PROBE preview artifact, and deleting an unread secret is not reversible.

The owner-kit item workflow_disabled requires provider-ui evidence from the n8n interface and stays false. It does not affect GPTBot: the route is 410 and the bearer is unbound. See N8N_RETIREMENT_DEVIATION.md.

Three repository tests fail on main and reproduce unchanged at d47d998, the previously live source: react-router-v8-migration 'preserves every public and admin route pattern' and 'sitemap generation retains all 234 static canonical entries' (240 are now emitted after the SEO content additions), and sotuvchi-onboarding 'buyer storefront route resolves the store but never launches seller onboarding' (the assertion reads the last delivered message, and the buyer greeting is no longer last since 04a8957). They are stale expectations, not runtime defects, and are unrelated to voice search. They should be re-baselined as their own change rather than inside a release.

The Pages Functions bundle is 2.09 MB of JavaScript because the whole GPTBot Functions tree compiles into one Worker, and every dynamic request pays its parse cost on a cold isolate. Measured against the Market launch endpoint from a remote client: 731 ms cold versus ~145 ms warm on the HMAC rejection path alone, before any D1 work. Splitting the tree is real work with real blast radius and was deliberately not attempted inside a latency fix. It is the next lever after Smart Placement if the launch is still not instant.

The Mini App BFF now reduces a typed sentence to its product words inside runCatalogSearch, so «Мне нужен блокнот» searches «блокнот». The Telegram bot does not: functions/agents/sotuvchi/buyer/parser.ts falls through to the raw normalized message when it is short enough, so the same sentence reaches rankCatalogProducts with the intent words attached and comes back with «Не нашли по условию: мне, нужен». The shared vocabulary lives in the Market layer, which the agent layer may not import, so closing this is a boundary decision (move the vocabulary to functions/platform, or give the parser its own) rather than a copy-paste. Left open deliberately instead of changing Telegram behaviour inside a Mini App release.
